title: Close deterministic extraction deficits and publish the baseline
objective: Deterministic results have a measured acceptance boundary and an explicit residual workload.
outcome: Every successful result has a matching capture/parser receipt; missing evidence prevents promotion. Residual jobs exclude credentials, missing evidence and forbidden access. No LLM task asks a model to discover a missing fact from memory; every residual includes an exact public passage or an explicit insufficient-evidence outcome. R03/R06 denominators are reproducible. A failed threshold stays failed. The next phase receives a concrete residual queue, not the entire corpus. The last good public generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 remains unchanged.

commits.subject: Reconcile successful and failed evidence
commits.instructions: Validate references, source-context bindings, parser coverage and timestamps over the full sweep. Preserve partial dictionaries and stale observations with their reasons.
commits.verification: Every successful result has a matching capture/parser receipt; missing evidence prevents promotion.

commits.subject: Create residual tasks from actual gaps
commits.instructions: Generate bounded residual jobs by source/document/field, excluding facts that require credentials, missing evidence or forbidden access. Route parser defects back to engineering.
commits.verification: No LLM task asks a model to discover a missing fact from memory; every task includes an exact public passage or an explicit insufficient-evidence outcome.

commits.subject: Publish a deterministic completion readout
commits.instructions: Report attempt coverage, parsed dictionary yield, working examples, unresolved essential fields and source differences. Add bounded follow-up PRs when an empirical target fails.
commits.verification: R03/R06 denominators are reproducible; a failed threshold stays failed and does not become an undocumented exception.
